name: Tongding Interconnection Information Co., Ltd.
summary: Tongding Interconnection Information Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, manufactures and sells optical and electrical cables in China and internationally. The company operates through three segments: Optoelectronic Communication Business; Security Business; and New Energy Business.
